messages:
incident-bot: Pager: metering.alert HIGH token-count-delta > 5000 in eu1
oncall-alex: seeing the alert, I'm on it. assigning to @billing-ana
billing-ana: taking it. initial look: agg delta spike starting ~1810003900, counts double for some customers
support-lina: any customer-visible overage flags yet? getting pings from CS
billing-ana: YES, two customers saw overage emails. investigating whether it's duplication or late-emits
eng-metrics: pulling emitter logs; preliminary: re-ordering in kafka consumer + duplicate ack replay on connector
sre-jeremy: any deploys around that time? check deploy-bot
incident-bot: Deploy notification: service/evictor v2.4.1 deployed to eu1 at 1810003840 by eng-release-bot
oncall-alex: hmm deploy ~3840 lines up. @mlops-rita can you check KV-cache TTL and prefix trimming? possible double-count due to tombstones
mlops-rita: checking KV cache. I see prefix flushes at 1810003838..3842, then consumer replay; potential race
billing-ana: logs show emit pipeline reprocessed acked messages. sample log:
```
2026-03-18T12:10:40Z INFO emitter emit id=abc123 attempts=1
2026-03-18T12:10:41Z WARN kafka reconnect partition=12 offset=45321
2026-03-18T12:10:43Z INFO emitter emit id=abc123 attempts=2
```
billing-ana: that id repeated -> duplication
support-lina: customers affected: cust_42 (invoice email), cust_77 (quota alert)
oncall-alex: mitigation plan: 1) pause emitter connector in eu1 2) enable dedupe mode on billing pipeline 3) kick off partial reconciliation job for window 1810003600-1810004200
sre-jeremy: I'll pause connector now. pausing connector eu1/emit-connector .. done (1810003985)
oncall-alex: thanks. @eng-metrics start dedupe flag, we'll hold outgoing emails until reconciliation complete
eng-metrics: toggled dedupe=true for billing pipeline (feature-flag service) at 1810004012
billing-ana: running reconciliation job (ad-hoc): `python tools/reconcile.py --start 1810003600 --end 1810004200 --mode=simulate`
mlops-rita: quick note: KV-cache TTL change in v2.4.1 was meant to reduce memory, but TTL write and evict overlapped with consumer restart -> re-emits
billing-ana: simulate shows ~4.8k duplicated tokens across 2 customers, matches alert
support-lina: notifying CS triage, marking impacted customers for credit hold. drafting message
support-lina: draft: "We detected duplicated usage events affecting your billing window; we've paused billing emails and are applying credits. We'll follow up once reconcile completes." - ok to send after confirm?
oncall-alex: hold until reconcile done. if duplicates > threshold we'll issue automatic credit + email
billing-ana: reconcile job finished (1810004510) -> dedup removed 4,812 duplicated tokens, adjustments queued
billing-ana: adjustments pushed to billing ledger, emails suppressed. will run final check in 30m
sre-jeremy: re-enabling connector with backpressure fix after canary: rolling restart of emit-connector + bump retry-policy to 3 (1810004560)
mlops-rita: created follow-up bug: KVCACHE-1422 "KV eviction vs consumer-reconnect duplication" assigned to infra-team
oncall-alex: postmortem ops: timeline, customer impact, mitigation, playbook update to include automatic pause on duplicate-detect. @billing-ana please own billing-side notes
billing-ana: will write billing notes and credits sheet
support-lina: CS message queued for manual send if any regressions. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigation in place, monitoring for reoccurrence. incident SEV3 -> monitoring
